stories.title: Donald Trump backs Irish unity in comments during Dublin visit
stories.details: During a visit to Dublin, Donald Trump made comments expressing support for Irish unity. The statement has drawn significant attention given the historical sensitivity of the topic and the context of his visit.

stories.title: Catherine Connolly raises ‘normalisation of war and genocide’ in ‘respectful’ meeting with US president
stories.details: Catherine Connolly held a meeting with the US president where she addressed concerns regarding the normalisation of war and genocide. The meeting was described as respectful despite the gravity of the issues discussed.

stories.title: Thousands protest Trump visit
stories.details: Thousands of protesters gathered on the streets of Dublin to oppose the visit of Donald Trump. The demonstration highlighted significant public dissent regarding his presence in the country.

stories.title: Don’t mention the war? Succeeding Trump is a tightrope for JD Vance
stories.details: Political analysis suggests that JD Vance faces a difficult challenge in navigating the political landscape as a potential successor to Donald Trump. The piece explores the complexities of maintaining party alignment while managing controversial policy stances.

stories.title: Remembering 9/11 at Ground Zero
stories.details: Reflections on the anniversary of the 9/11 attacks at Ground Zero. The story captures the somber mood and the enduring impact of the tragedy on the families and the nation.

stories.title: Christopher Harborne matches £36m Reform donation of Ben Delo
stories.details: Reform UK has received a massive financial boost with two separate £36 million donations from Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne. The influx of £72 million has significantly altered the political funding landscape in the UK.

stories.title: Burnham must understand Wales is ‘not a region in England’, says first minister
stories.details: First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth issued a sharp rebuke to Andy Burnham, asserting that Wales is a distinct nation rather than a region of England. The comments highlight ongoing tensions regarding regional governance and identity.

stories.title: Tesco alerts police as supermarket becomes latest victim of scam ‘endorsement’ ads
stories.details: Tesco has contacted the police after becoming the target of fraudulent endorsement advertisements. The scam uses the brand's reputation to deceive consumers, prompting a security response.

stories.title: UK government to offer clearer guidance on student loans after repayment row
stories.details: Following a public dispute over repayment terms, the UK government has committed to providing more transparent guidance for student loans. The move aims to resolve confusion among borrowers regarding their financial obligations.

stories.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is escalating
stories.details: A group of Fields Medal winners has signed an open letter criticizing AI labs like OpenAI for their race to solve math problems. The conflict involves allegations of plagiarism, lack of attribution, and the pressure to prioritize secrecy over open research.

stories.title: Meta AI profiled a mom's kids
stories.details: Meta's AI tool was found to have compiled a detailed profile of a user's children by scraping personal data from years of social media posts. Meta acknowledged the feature 'missed the mark' and has since addressed the privacy issue.

stories.title: NASA, IBM launch lunar AI model
stories.details: NASA and IBM have released an open-source AI model designed to analyze lunar data. The system is capable of identifying craters and volcanic formations with higher accuracy than previous methods.

stories.title: State hackers used Claude to build weapons
stories.details: Anthropic reported that state-sponsored actors from Russia, China, and Iran have misused its Claude chatbot to assist in weapon development. The activities included drone swarm software and anti-torpedo research.

stories.title: Meta's slim Project Phoenix headset leaks
stories.details: Images of Meta's upcoming lightweight mixed reality headset, codenamed Project Phoenix, have leaked. The device features a glasses-like design and is expected to focus on hand-tracking technology.

stories.title: Guimarães and Saka fire Arsenal to win at Sunderland
stories.details: Arsenal secured a victory against Sunderland with goals from Guimarães and Saka. The win was bolstered by a crucial penalty save from goalkeeper Raya, extending Arsenal's winning start to the season.

stories.title: Palace merited last-gasp win over Liverpool, admits Slot
stories.details: Crystal Palace claimed a dramatic late victory over Liverpool. Manager Arne Slot admitted that Palace deserved the result after a hard-fought performance.

stories.title: Alvarez double floors Real Madrid to give Atlético derby spoils
stories.details: Julian Alvarez scored twice to lead Atlético Madrid to a derby victory over Real Madrid. The result provided a significant boost to Atlético's campaign in La Liga.

stories.title: Martin O’Neill: ‘Expected goals is a clueless development’
stories.details: Former manager Martin O’Neill criticized the use of 'expected goals' (xG) in football analysis. He dismissed the metric as a 'clueless development' and 'nonsense' in a recent interview.

stories.title: England outclass Canada to capture Women's Rugby World Cup
stories.details: England's women's rugby team defeated Canada to win the World Cup on home soil. The dominant performance secured the trophy for the hosts.

stories.title: Flying Kurt-Lee Arendse helps South Africa clinch New Zealand series
stories.details: South Africa secured a series victory over New Zealand in rugby union. Kurt-Lee Arendse played a pivotal role in the decisive matches.

stories.title: Shane Lowry shows his steel to extend Irish Open lead
stories.details: Shane Lowry maintained his composure to extend his lead at the Irish Open. The golfer demonstrated resilience to stay ahead of the field in the elite tournament.

stories.title: Elena Rybakina beats Aryna Sabalenka to seal US Open title
stories.details: Elena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka in a dramatic final to win the US Open. The victory marks a significant milestone in Rybakina's career.

stories.title: Solheim Cup: Hull and Woad flop for Europe as Kupcho pulls USA level
stories.details: The Solheim Cup saw a shift in momentum as the USA leveled the score. Poor performances from Europe's Hull and Woad allowed Kupcho to bring the USA back into contention.

stories.title: The last Irish nuns in Africa: ‘There was no question of going home’
stories.details: A poignant look at the lives of the final Irish nuns serving in Africa. The story explores their commitment to their mission and their decision to remain abroad despite the challenges.

stories.title: Margaret Atwood: ‘God made the middle finger for a reason’
stories.details: In a candid interview, literary icon Margaret Atwood discusses her life, her work, and her uncompromising perspective on aging and femininity.

stories.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones: The secret of our marriage is that I kept working
stories.details: Catherine Zeta-Jones reflects on her career and marriage in a frank interview. She attributes the longevity of her relationship to her continued professional pursuits.

stories.title: I was arrested and convicted for letting my five-year-old walk alone
stories.details: A mother shares her experience of being placed on a child abuse register after allowing her young son to walk unsupervised in a gated community.
